Exam Date & Time: 25-Apr-2023 (09:30 AM - 12:30 PM)  
  
  
  MANIPAL ACADEMY OF HIGHER EDUCATION  
  FIRST SEMESTER B.TECH. (MAKEUP) EXAMINATIONS - APRIL 2023  
  SUBJECT: CHM-1071 / CHM -1051 - ENGINEERING CHEMISTRY  
  (REGULARS - LATE ADMISSION BATCH)  
  Engineering Chemistry [CHM-1071]  
Marks: 50                                                                             Duration: 180 mins.  
  A  
Answer all the questions.  
1A)          Explain the construction and working of lithium ion batteries. Mention any two  
  advantages of it.  
  (3)  
  i)  
  ii)    Give reason: Aqueous electrolytes are not preferred in lithium ion batteries.                 (1)  
1B)          What is the pH of the solution when the cell Pt | H2| H+(x)|| KCl (0.2 M) | Hg2Cl2|Hg is  
  set up at 298 K, which provides an EMF of 0.65 V? (EMF of normal calomel electrode            (3)  
  is 0.2810 V).  
  i)  
  ii)    Explain the Poggendorff's compensation method for EMF determination.                          (1)  
1C)          Give reasons for the following:  
  (i) Proper water management is crucial for the efficient operation of PEMFC.  
  (ii) Calculate the EMF of the cell Au | Au3+ (1M)|| Al3+(1M) | Al. Comment on the             (2)  
  feasibility of this cell.  
  
2A)          The concentration of yeast t-RNA in an aqueous solution is 10 M. The absorbance is  
  found to be 0.209 when this Solution is placed in a 1.00 cm cuvette and 258 nm  
  radiations are passed through it. (a) Calculate the specific absorptivity, including units,   (2)  
  i)     of yeast t-RNA. and (b) What will be the absorbance if the solution is 5 M?  
  
  ii)    Explain the conductometric titration of weak acid Vs strong base with illustration.           (2)  
2B)          Define reverse osmosis. Describe with a neat diagram how sea water is purified using  
  this technique. Write any two advantages of it.                                               (4)  
  
2C)          (i) Define electrodialysis.  
  (ii) Distinguish between hard water and soft water.                                           (2)  
  
3A)          Explain the best suited corrosion protection method for those metals / alloys which  
  exhibit passivity. Also explain why this technique fails if corrosive medium contains         (4)  
  chloride ions.  
  
3B)          Describe caustic embrittlement of mild steel. Describe the criteria for material selection  
  that must be considered while trying to prevent metal corrosion.                           (4)  
  
3C)          Explain the effect of temperature on the rate of corrosion of:                                (2)  
  i) Metal submerged in water containing dissolved O2  
  ii) Stainless steel in HNO3

4A)             i) Describe the working of liquid crystals in display system.  
  ii) With reference to composites differentiate between;  
  a) Large particle and dispersion strengthened                                         (4)  
  b) Matrix and dispersed phase  
  
4B)             i) Describe the vacuum deposition process of obtaining thin film.  
  ii) Explain the ball milling method for preparation of nano-material.                 (4)  
  
4C)             Calculate the number average and weight average molecular weight of a polymer  
  sample in which 40% molecules have molecular mass of 25000, 20% have molecular        (2)  
  mass of 30000 and rest have molecular mass of 55000.  
  
5A)             Explain the methods of cleaning the metal surface before electroplating.  
  (4)  
  
5B)             Identify and explain the coating method which is employed for the coating of optical  
  lenses with inorganic materials such as MgF2, Al2O3 and SiO2? List any two advantages (4)  
  and disadvantages of the method.  
  
5C)             How does the nature of the film decide the further corrosion process in oxidation  
  corrosion?                                                                            (2)  
  
  
-----End-----
